profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a passionate and results-driven Senior Software Engineer with 7 years of experience in software development. My journey in the world of technology has been marked by a pursuit of excellence, a knack for solving complex problems, and a commitment to innovation.

My expertise spans a wide spectrum of programming languages, including Python, Go, C#, C/C++, PHP, JavaScript, and SQL. I have a proven track record of not only writing code but also optimizing it for maximum performance and efficiency.

One of my proudest accomplishments is successfully leading the migration of a complex legacy 3PL system into a modern environment, demonstrating my adaptability and problem-solving skills. I thrive in challenging environments and have a passion for streamlining processes, whether it's through code optimization, API integration, or logistics enhancement.

Beyond my technical skills, I've had the privilege of leading multiple development teams. This role has allowed me to take ownership of projects, providing insights into performance and facilitating the professional growth of team members. Additionally, I have actively engaged with key customers, offering my technical expertise and guidance at various stages of development, ensuring successful outcomes.

Beyond my professional endeavors, I have a keen interest in composing orchestral and electronic music. I also possess proficiency in 3D printing using tools like Blender and a Prusa i3. My passion for technology extends to designing hardware and developing software for embedded systems, where I've leveraged an array of technologies, from Raspberry Pi's and barcode scanners to sensors, cameras, and more. I've also excelled in creating secure software solutions for data syncing among custom designed portable devices, harnessing Bluetooth technology to ensure efficient communication within networks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Technical Contributions:
Successfully led the migration of a legacy 3PL system to a modern environment, enhancing accessibility and adaptability.
Designed a console based user interface for interactive Linux terminal sessions.
Implemented codebase optimizations with reusable utilities, improving code performance, readability, and efficiency.
Developed user-friendly REST API software and established a comprehensive API delivery system, simplifying data exchange with internal and external systems.
Introduced logistics tools that substantially improved distribution operations and addressed operational challenges effectively.
Designed data parsing and generation tools, enabling versatile data handling across various formats and protocols.
Provided valuable code templates, reducing development time and enhancing software functionality.
Pioneered automation of core business processes through data-driven solutions, minimizing manual triggers and data entry.
Implemented an efficient version control system for code management and seamless collaboration among development teams.
Designed a comprehensive 3PL system encompassing inventory management, order fulfillment (SFTP, API, custom integrations), distribution (backorders, returns, receiving, adjustments, transfers, picking, packing, shipping), and accounting software (payment, invoice, statement).
Deployed real-time productivity metrics and efficiency reports systems, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
Leadership and Mentorship:
Led multiple development teams, taking charge of project ownership and offering valuable insights into performance and skill development.
Mentored junior engineers, fostering their professional growth and development.
Collaborated closely with key customers, providing technical expertise and guidance at various stages of development.
positions.insights: Application Programming Interfaces (API), Raspberry Pi and +14 skills
